name: Nori
description: Paper-thin roasted seaweed sheets, wrapped or crumbled into soup.

tcm.note: Zi cai is cold and softens hardness — the seaweeds are a cooling group in TCM.

histamine.note: Dried and aged sea products carry histamine; seaweed is a known trigger for the sensitive.

nutrition.highlight: one sheet holds more iodine than a day needs
